name: The Lake City Spell
hook: Three days of lakes, palaces and golden hours in Udaipur.

about.heading: The city that floats
about.body:
Udaipur doesn't feel built — it feels **conjured**. Palaces balance on water, old bridges hum with songs, and every second doorway sells a painting smaller than your palm.

For three days we live inside it: one day for the old city and its ghats, one for the hills and lakes around it, and one last fort on the road home.

- Two sunsets, one sunrise, zero rush
- Old-city bazaars & miniature paintings
- A picnic in the hills you'll talk about for months
about.quote: Some cities you visit. Udaipur, you drift through.

itinerary.title: Arrive Into the Lake City
itinerary.subtitle: Palaces, ghats & bazaar gold
itinerary.description:
Check in over a slow breakfast, then step straight into the old city. The morning belongs to **City Palace** — balconies, mirror-work and Lake Pichola glittering below. Lunch at **Rainbow**, with the lake doing the decorating.

From there it's all on foot: the bells of **Jagdish Temple**, the evening **puppet show at Bagore Ki Haveli**, the quiet steps of **Gangaur Ghat** and a walk across **Chand Pole Puliya**. We lose ourselves in the bazaar hunting **miniature paintings**, catch sunset from **Ambrai Ghat**, and end the day with dinner at a cute little café.

highlights.text: Lakeside lunch at Rainbow, above Lake Pichola
Evening puppet show at Bagore Ki Haveli
Miniature-painting hunt through the old bazaar
Sunset at Ambrai Ghat, City Palace across the water

itinerary.title: Sunrise Hills & a Palace in the Clouds
itinerary.subtitle: The day we earn our views
itinerary.description:
Alarms at dark, no regrets: we climb **Bahubali Hill** while the city sleeps and watch sunrise pour over Badi Lake. Then the day slows down — a **Spellbound picnic lunch** in the **Raita Hills**, the fountains of **Saheliyon Ki Bari**, long easy walks along **Fateh Sagar** and a stroll through **Nehru Park**.

As golden hour arrives, we drive up to the **Monsoon Palace** and watch the whole lake city glow below.

highlights.text: Sunrise trek up Bahubali Hill over Badi Lake
The Spellbound picnic in the Raita Hills

itinerary.title: One Last Fort, Then Home
itinerary.subtitle: The long goodbye
itinerary.description:
One last slow breakfast before checkout. We ride up to **Karni Mata Mandir** for a final view over the lakes, then point the wheels toward **Chittorgarh** — walking its ramparts as the fort turns gold at **sunset**.

From there, it's onward to **Delhi**, tired in the best way.

host.name: Mehar Sachdev
host.title: Your Udaipur Spellcaster
host.about: Mehar collects golden hours the way other people collect fridge magnets — and knows exactly which ghat, which rooftop and which chai stall Udaipur saves for the patient. Expect slow mornings, long walks and zero group-tour energy.
host.quote: The lake does the magic. I just gather the people.

stay.name: Lasani Homestay
stay.shortDescription: A family-run homestay in Udaipur's old city — our home base, minutes from the lake.
stay.longDescription: Warm hosts, home-cooked breakfasts and rooftop moments over the old city. Small, personal and exactly the opposite of a hotel chain — find them at **@lasanihomestayudaipur** on Instagram.

audience.title: The Screen-Tired
audience.description: You've been everywhere online and nowhere in weeks. Udaipur asks nothing of you but your attention.

audience.title: The Solo First-Timer
audience.description: Come alone, leave with a table of friends and a camera roll full of ghats.

audience.title: The Golden-Hour Chaser
audience.description: Two sunsets, one sunrise and a palace in the clouds. Bring the good lens.

tripHighlights.title: Sunrise from Bahubali Hill
tripHighlights.description: A pre-dawn climb, then Badi Lake turning silver-gold beneath you.

tripHighlights.title: Golden hour at Ambrai Ghat
tripHighlights.description: The City Palace lit across the water — Udaipur's most famous view, earned slowly.

tripHighlights.title: Puppet show at Bagore Ki Haveli
tripHighlights.description: Rajasthani music, dance and string puppets in a centuries-old haveli on Gangaur Ghat.

tripHighlights.title: Chittorgarh at sunset
tripHighlights.description: India's largest fort as the last light hits — the goodbye that doesn't feel like one.

faqs.question: How hard is the Bahubali Hill trek?
faqs.answer: A short, steep pre-dawn climb — around 30–40 minutes at an easy pace. Sneakers are enough, and the sunrise pays for every step.

faqs.question: I'm coming solo — will I fit in?
faqs.answer: Most of the circle usually does. By the first ghat sunset, strangers feel like a travel family.

faqs.question: What should I pack?
faqs.answer: Light layers, sneakers for the trek, sunscreen — and space in your bag for miniature paintings.
